rows.name: data
rows.description: Data for the ODSDonutChart. Similar to the data property provided by the Chartjs library.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Options for the ODSDonutChart. Similar to the options property provided by the Chartjs library.

rows.name: centerContent
rows.description: React node rendered in the center of the donut hole. Positioned over the chart using absolute layout, centred on the inner circle.

rows.name: content
rows.description: List of elements to be displayed on the chart. Maximum number of elements is equal to the number of slices. Each element is positioned on the middle of each slice.

rows.name: type
rows.description: The type of the chart to be rendered.

rows.name: onSliceClick
rows.description: Callback function triggered when a slice is clicked. Provides the index of the clicked slice, or null if no slice is clicked.

rows.name: onSliceHover
rows.description: Callback function triggered when a slice is hovered. Provides the index of the hovered slice, or null if no slice is hovered.

rows.name: onSliceFocus
rows.description: Callback function triggered when a slice is focused. Provides the focused point, or null if no slice is focused.
